verdict.rationale: Directory sync via SCIM is a fair axis for an auth and user-management provider, but the evidence pack never mentions SCIM, directory or group provisioning, or IdP-driven deprovisioning. The closest item says Enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) users 'have their user data synchronized with Clerk' when they sign in. That is an adjacent SSO capability, not SCIM push provisioning or deprovisioning, so it earns no credit for this story.
